summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed an Amendment No. 1 to a preliminary pricing supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a $ offering of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due October 18, 2032. The notes are linked to the worst-performing of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, Russell 2000 Index, and S&P 500 Index, with a $1,000 issue price per note and a $25.50 quarterly contingent coupon. This is a routine shelf takedown under an existing Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program, not a special-situations event; the offering is subject to completion and final terms are not yet set.
